collection.title: Audi A8 1994 to 2001 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit an Audi A8 1994 to 2001 model which requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook type wiper arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: Audi A8/S8 Non-Integrated Washer Jets 1994 to 2001 Windscreen Wiper Blades
